status: PASS: independent read-only five-Boolean integer-sum source and mathematical review

scope.coefficients_tested: exactly five nonzero coefficients, each -1 or +1; arbitrary integer coefficients are not claimed

mathematics.inequality: For integer L and k, (L-k)(L-k-1)>=0 pointwise. Summed over labelled embeddings it is q-(2k+1)p+k(k+1)g.
mathematics.minimum: F(k+1)-F(k)=2g(k+1)-2p. For g>0, floor(p/g) is a minimizer; when p/g is integral the neighboring lower integer ties.
mathematics.sign_reduction: Replacing all signs by their negatives maps the full shift family by k->-k-1, so the first coefficient may be fixed to +1.
mathematics.moments: q uses binary diagonals, which are checked exactly against the first row. Negative reconstruction uses coefficient 1-(2k+1)s_i on each first moment and 2s_i*s_j on each cross moment.
mathematics.zero_root: g=0 is handled separately and requires the entire exact matrix to vanish; it is not inferred from the root count alone.
mathematics.no_lower_support_claim_from_this_scan: Smaller supports belong to previously checked Boolean marginals, not to this exact-five support enumeration.

arithmetic.initial_contractions: All sparse coefficient-count contractions use Python integers before int64 conversion.
arithmetic.matrix_guard: For nonconstant roots, all contracted entries are nonnegative and 256*B<=INT64_MAX, with B the largest entry.
arithmetic.first_moment_guard: 0<=M0i<=g gives -4g<=p<=5g for the retained signs and hence -4<=floor(p/g)<=5.
arithmetic.intermediate_bounds: |p|<=5B; |q|<=25B; |(2k+1)p|<=55B; |k(k+1)g|<=30B. The full expression and its partial evaluations are bounded in absolute value by110B, below the checked256B bound.
arithmetic.constant_only_roots: They have no five-subsets and perform no batched functional arithmetic.
arithmetic.negative_gate: Every accepted negative is re-expanded in Python integers through the bound scalar tensor and exact automorphism factors; exact value and positive-gcd form must agree.
arithmetic.timeout: Only completely checked roots are included; incomplete/error/timeout status does not become a complete-family claim.
